class.name: FellowStreamingCell3D
class.brief_description: FellowEngine: a cell of a streamed world, its content a [PackedScene] loaded and freed by a [FellowWorldStreamer3D].
class.description: Placed below a [FellowWorldStreamer3D], the cell's [member scene_path] is loaded on the [ResourceLoader]'s threads when a camera or target comes within [member load_distance] of its [member bounds] (the streamer's distance if 0), instantiated on a worker thread and added as the cell's child; beyond the distance plus the streamer's [member FellowWorldStreamer3D.unload_margin] it is freed. The cell's own [Node3D] children are its proxy: shown while the content is not in the tree (an HLOD mesh, a low-detail stand-in, the [code]FellowProxy[/code] that [method FellowWorldStreamer3D.bake_proxies] makes), hidden while it is. In the editor the content is shown, not loaded into the level (see [member FellowWorldStreamer3D.editor_preview]), and a baked proxy is hidden while it is. See [code]docs/decisions/0147-world-streaming.md[/code].

method.name: get_content
method.description: The content's root node while it is loaded ([constant STATE_READY] or [constant STATE_LOADED]), otherwise [code]null[/code].

method.name: get_state
method.description: Where the content is: unloaded, loading, being instantiated, ready to enter the tree or in it.

method.name: is_loaded
method.description: The content is in the tree.

members.member: The cell's extent in its own space: the distance to a camera is measured to this box.
The distance from the box at which the content loads; 0: the streamer's [member FellowWorldStreamer3D.load_distance].
The [PackedScene] file of the cell's content.

signal.name: unloaded
signal.description: The content left the tree (it is freed).
